text: Krsna is a DHH artist. Krsna profile: Born in Kashmir and raised in London, Krsna built his adult life and career in Delhi. Known as a lyrical genius in the DHH scene, his command over both English and Hindi makes him one of the most versatile MCs in the game. His sharp wordplay and dense rhyme schemes have earned him a reputation as one of the finest technical rappers India has ever produced. Slug: krsna

Seedhe Maut is a DHH artist. Seedhe Maut profile: Seedhe Maut is a Delhi-based hip hop duo consisting of Encore ABJ (Abhijay Negi, roots in Uttarakhand) and Calm (Siddhant Sharma, from Nainital). The two met at SpitDope Delhi and built one of the most beloved acts in Desi Hip Hop. Their discography — Bayaan, Naayab, the 30-song mixtape Lunch Break — has been an unbroken run of bangers. They now run their own label, DL91. Slug: seedhemaut

Naam Sujal is a DHH artist. Naam Sujal profile: Born and raised in Nagpur, Naam Sujal is a 19-year-old forcing the DHH scene to pay attention. Runner-up on Hustle Season 4, he followed that spotlight with Mamafication — a project packed with standout tracks that proved his placement in the scene is no accident. One of the youngest and hungriest voices in the game right now. Slug: naamsujal

Raftaar is a DHH artist. Raftaar profile: Born Dilin Nair, Raftaar is one of the most versatile names in Indian hip-hop - rapper, producer, dancer, and TV personality with releases spanning Hindi, Punjabi, and Haryanvi music. One of the early figures who brought Desi hip-hop into mainstream visibility. Slug: raftaar

Arpit Bala is a DHH artist. Arpit Bala profile: Arpit Bala (also known as Arpit Balabantaray) is an Odia-background rapper, streamer, and YouTube creator who crossed over into music as part of the rap duo Foosie Gang. Known for blending comedy and hip-hop, he built a significant following through YouTube and Instagram. Slug: arpit-bala

Chaar Diwari is a DHH artist. Chaar Diwari profile: Chaar Diwari is the alias of 22-year-old Garv Taneja - producer, singer, songwriter, and visual artist in the Desi hip-hop community. Known for experimental Hindi music and projects like the EP Teri Maiyat Ke Gaane, he also directs and curates his own music videos. Slug: chaar-diwari

Divine is a DHH artist. Divine profile: Mumbai rapper Vivian Fernandes, one of the most recognisable voices of Indian street rap and the founder of Gully Gang Entertainment. His story and his work with Naezy helped inspire the film Gully Boy. Slug: divine
Naezy is a DHH artist. Naezy profile: Mumbai rapper Naved Shaikh, a pioneer of Mumbai street rap whose story, together with Divine's, inspired the film Gully Boy. Slug: naezy

Emiway Bantai is a DHH artist. Emiway Bantai profile: Mumbai rapper who runs the independent label Bantai Records and built a huge following through Hindi rap releases put out on his own terms. Slug: emiway-bantai
MC Stan is a DHH artist. MC Stan profile: Pune rapper Altaf Shaikh, known for hard-hitting Hindi rap and a loyal fanbase. He won Bigg Boss 16 in 2023. Slug: mc-stan
Badshah is a DHH artist. Badshah profile: Delhi-based rapper, singer and producer Aditya Prateek Singh Sisodia, who blends Hindi and Punjabi rap with mainstream pop. Slug: badshah
Yo Yo Honey Singh is a DHH artist. Yo Yo Honey Singh profile: Rapper and producer who brought Punjabi-Hindi hip hop into the Bollywood mainstream in the early 2010s. Slug: yo-yo-honey-singh
Prabh Deep is a DHH artist. Prabh Deep profile: Delhi rapper and songwriter known for raw, socially aware storytelling. His debut album Class-Sikh came out in 2017. Slug: prabh-deep
Brodha V is a DHH artist. Brodha V profile: Bengaluru-based rapper and producer known for blending hip hop with South Indian musical influences. Slug: brodha-v
King is a DHH artist. King profile: Indian singer-rapper whose melodic hip-hop and pop crossover tracks found a huge audience online. Slug: king
Hanumankind is a DHH artist. Hanumankind profile: Rapper Sooraj Cherukat, born in Kerala and based in Houston, whose track Big Dawgs went viral worldwide in 2024. Slug: hanumankind
Sofia Ashraf is a DHH artist. Sofia Ashraf profile: Chennai rapper and activist whose viral protest track Kodaikanal Won't (2015) called out mercury pollution. Slug: sofia-ashraf
Hard Kaur is a DHH artist. Hard Kaur profile: UK-born rapper Taran Kaur Dhillon, known as one of the early female hip-hop artists in India. Slug: hard-kaur
Baba Sehgal is a DHH artist. Baba Sehgal profile: A pioneer of Indian pop-rap in the 1990s who helped introduce rap to a mainstream Hindi audience. Slug: baba-sehgal
Kaam Bhaari is a DHH artist. Kaam Bhaari profile: Mumbai rapper associated with the Gully Gang crew. Slug: kaam-bhaari
Swadesi is a DHH artist. Swadesi profile: Mumbai-based hip-hop collective known for socially conscious, street-rooted music. Slug: swadesi
MC Tod Fod is a DHH artist. MC Tod Fod profile: Mumbai rapper and member of the Swadesi collective. Slug: mc-tod-fod
Vedan is a DHH artist. Vedan profile: Kerala rapper Hirandas Murali, known for Malayalam rap with sharp social and political themes. Slug: vedan
Arivu is a DHH artist. Arivu profile: Tamil singer-rapper and songwriter Arivarasu Kalainesan, who co-created and performed Enjoy Enjaami (2021) with Dhee. Slug: arivu
